directions.name: Outer-product Matmul 4x4
directions.summary: Loop order (k, i, j) with sA in a single cell at address 1 and sB at addresses 3..6
directions.prompt: Implement the outer product loop order (k, i, j) for a 4x4 matrix multiplication. Lay out memory such that the single-cell cache sA is at address 1, the temporary variable is at address 2, sB is at addresses 3..6, C is at addresses 7..22, A bulk is at 23..38, and B bulk is at 39..54. For each k, copy B[k, j] to sB[j]. Then for each i, copy A[i, k] to sA, and for each j, perform the multiplication, accumulating into C[i, j].

directions.name: Inner-product Cached Matmul 4x4
directions.summary: Loop order (i, j, k) with cached rows of A at low addresses
directions.prompt: Implement the inner product loop order (i, j, k) for a 4x4 matrix multiplication. Try caching a row of A in low addresses before multiplying. Lay out memory to minimize average Manhattan distance for hot variables.
